subject: Briefing window surrendered — pause demo after roadmap pivot
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Emily Rivera <emily@kineticlabs.com>, procurement@kineticlabs.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-09T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kinetic Labs — quick 30m briefing options

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for taking the time during the initial discovery call last week. Per our convo, would you and the team be available for a 30-minute technical briefing/demo next week so we can show the inference latency/cost profile and discuss dedicated vs hosted options? I pulled a few windows below — happy to flex: 

- Tue 4/16, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 4/17, 14:30–15:00 PT
- Thu 4/18, 09:00–09:30 PT

If those don’t work, tell me a couple of times that suit your engineering lead and procurement and I’ll send a calendar invite.

I’ll plan to have a short mutual action plan ready after the session so procurement can see next steps.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
tessa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0134

From: Emily Rivera <emily@kineticlabs.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@kineticlabs.com
Date: 2028-04-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kinetic Labs — quick 30m briefing options

Hi Tessa —

Appreciate the follow-up and the slots. I need to pause the demo scheduling for now — we just got pulled into a product launch sprint that reassigns our ML and infra band to a hard deadline in Q2. Between travel and the launch freeze, we’ve deprioritized new vendor evaluations for the next 8–10 weeks.

Please remove the tentative calendar holds and hold off on SOW/discussion until we re-open the procurement window. I’ll ask that procurement remain looped (they’re cc’d).

I’m happy to revisit after we come out of the launch sprint — can we check back in mid-June?

Thanks for understanding,
Emily Rivera
VP of Engineering
Kinetic Labs

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Emily Rivera <emily@kineticlabs.com>, procurement@kineticlabs.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-09T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kinetic Labs — quick 30m briefing options

Emily —

Totally understand and thanks for the clarity. We’ll remove the holds on our side and mark the opportunity as "briefing paused — customer sprint" in HubSpot. I’ve cc’d Jordan (Solutions Eng) and Marissa (GTMS) so they’re aware.

A couple quick options from our side to keep things moving without taking your team’s calendar time while you’re heads-down: 

- I’ll send a concise pre-recorded demo (10–12 minutes) that highlights latency comparisons and the Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs for workloads similar to yours. You can share it internally on your timeline. (Attachment: redwood-demo-walkthrough.mp4)
- I’ll attach an abbreviated mutual action plan you can drop into procurement when the window re-opens. (Attachment: mutual-action-plan-draft.pdf)
- We can set a single follow-up check-in for the week of June 17th — I’ll tentatively propose Tue 2028-06-18 and will convert to an open HubSpot task rather than a calendar hold; if you prefer a different date we’ll update.

Also — as a courtesy for the delay, we’re prepared to extend an introductory credit (90 days) on Dedicated trials for Kinetic Labs once you’re ready to re-engage — no action required now, we’ll preserve the offer while you complete the launch.

If that sounds fine I’ll: 1) send the two attachments now, 2) create a HubSpot follow-up for 2028-06-18, and 3) remove any tentative invites so you don’t receive calendar noise.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Rivera <emily@kineticlabs.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, procurement@kineticlabs.com
Date: 2028-04-09T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kinetic Labs — quick 30m briefing options

Thanks Tessa — that approach works well. Please go ahead and: 

1) Send the pre-recorded demo link and MAP PDF so I can distribute internally.
2) Create the HubSpot task for week of 6/17; Tue 6/18 is fine as a placeholder.

We’ll remove the tentative holds on our side. If anything changes with the launch timeline I’ll ping you earlier. Appreciate the credit offer — helpful.

Emily
VP of Engineering
Kinetic Labs
